title.en: The LZ-60 Order Is 50 m³/h and a Printed 100 / 125 mm Pipe
title.zh: LZ-60 的订单是 50 m³/h 和印出的 100 / 125 mm 管

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints LZ-60 at 145 kW, 50 m³/h, aggregate 4 cm and below and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Diesel 60 does not print that pipe.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 LZ-60 印成 145 kW、50 m³/h、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm。柴油60不印这根管子。

h1.en: Order LZ-60 When You Need Those Printed Cells
h1.zh: 需要这些已印格子时订 LZ-60

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 as 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m, delivery height 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, outline 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m and 5500 kg. Hopper volume is not printed. If your order must cite 100 / 125 mm and 50 m³/h together, this is the page that prints both. Diesel 60 prints 35 m³/h and no pipe cell. Send the LZ-60 path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/). No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132 印成 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m、5500 kg。没有印料斗容积。如果订单必须同时引用 100 / 125 mm 和 50 m³/h，印出这两项的是这一页。柴油60印 35 m³/h，并且没有管径格。把 LZ-60 路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。没有印价格。

body.en: The outline is published as 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. Quote it in metres unless you mark a conversion as your own.
body.zh: 外形以 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m 公布。除非你标明换算是你自己做的，否则用米来引用。

body.en: The label is conveying distance, and 300 m is delivery height. Do not restack them into Electric 80’s H / V style without saying you copied different labels.
body.zh: 标题是输送距离，300 m 是输送高度。不要在不说明的情况下把它们排成电动80那种 H / V 写法。

body.en: That weight is LZ-60. Diesel 60 is 3500 kg. The shared code does not share the crate.
body.zh: 这个重量是 LZ-60。柴油60是 3500 kg。共享代码不共享箱子。

answer.zh: 不是。是 145 kW。144 kW 是柴油60。
